newsitem.title: USA: Pa. fiscal 1997 revenues $576 mln above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Pa. fiscal 1997 revenues $576 mln above estimates.

text.p: Pennsylvania revenues totalled $17.3 billion in fiscal 1997, $576 million more than predicted, the state's Department of Revenue said.
All major tax categories ended the fiscal year on June 30 above estimate, state officials said.
Sales and use taxes totalled $6 billion, 3.2 percent more than expected, while personal income tax collections ended the year $236 million, or 4.3 percent, above estimate.
Total corporation taxes were 1.7 percent higher than expected, and total consumption taxes beat expectations by 3.0 percent.
